_readme: IRIS screen names can change. Every row is UNVERIFIED. Check the current IRIS screens.

salary.head: Income from Salary
salary.iris: IRIS return, Salary section (gross salary, tax deducted by employer)

bank_profit.head: Profit on debt (other sources)
bank_profit.iris: IRIS return, Income from other sources / profit on debt, and withholding credit

withholding_certificate.head: Tax already withheld
withholding_certificate.iris: IRIS return, Adjustable / final tax withheld section (match the section on the certificate)

freelance_remittance.head: Income from business (export of services)
freelance_remittance.iris: IRIS return, Business income / export of services, with the PRC number noted
